title: Epimorphic cycle representatives for the left decalage interval
statement: Let \(C\) be abelian, \(U=(K,F)\) a filtered cochain complex, \(D=\operatorname{Dec}(F)\) [def-sp-filtered-complex-decalage-tower], \(p,q,r\in\mathbb Z\), \(r\ge2\), and \(n=p+q\). Suppose \(a+n=p\) and \(b+n+1=p+r\). If \(k:R_r^{p,n}(F)\to D^aK^n\) lifts the ambient representative inclusion [def-sp-filtered-complex-decalage-page-data], there exists an epimorphism \(g:R_r^{p,n}(F)\to Z^n(D^a/D^b)\) such that its composite with the cycle inclusion is \(k\) followed by the quotient projection.

proof.text: The derivative of k belongs to D^b: its ambient image is in F^(p+r), and its next derivative vanishes. Lift k followed by the quotient projection to quotient cycles.

proof.text: Test epimorphy up to refinements. Lift an arbitrary quotient cycle along the epic degreewise quotient map. Its derivative lifts into D^b after another epimorphic refinement, by exactness of the quotient sequence. The equations a+n=p and b+n+1=p+r and the decalage intersection formula show that this lifted element is an original r-cycle. Factor it through the representative pullback and cancel the quotient-cycle inclusion to obtain the required lift.

theorem filteredComplexDecalageLeftRepresentatives
    (U : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ)) (p q r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (a b : ℤ) (ha : a + (p + q) = p) (hb : b + (p + q + 1) = p + r)
    (k : (U.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) r : C) ⟶
      (U.filtration.decalage.step a : CochainComplex C ℤ).X (p + q))
    (hk : k ≫ (U.filtration.decalage.step a).arrow.f (p + q) =
      (U.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) r).arrow ≫
        (U.filtration.step p).arrow.f (p + q)) :
    let Q := U.filtration.decalage.complexQuotient a b (by omega)
    ∃ g : (U.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) r : C) ⟶ Q.cycles (p + q),
      Epi g ∧ g ≫ Q.iCycles (p + q) =
        k ≫ (U.filtration.decalage.complexQuotientπ a b (by omega)).f (p + q)
